harper: Quick sync: need a small model-catalog update about quantized embedding compatibility for AuroraX variants. Found customer confusion about dtype mismatches and search score drift. Can someone own a short note + example?

leo: I can. Plan: add compatibility table for quant/dtype, a tiny example of embeddings cast to float32 before similarity, and a short note about expected score delta (~0.02-0.05). ETA today.

nina: Add a caution about downstream indexing: some vector DBs treat floats differently and may need explicit schema change. Include exact reindex commands for our supported DBs (pinecone, qdrant).

ash: I'll drop the qdrant reindex snippet. Also include a simple Python snippet showing dtype cast and normalization: `vec = np.array(raw).astype(np.float32); vec /= np.linalg.norm(vec)`

leo: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/933 1 - includes table, examples, and a short benchmark note.
